body.x: Smart content center(www.smartcontent.kr) showcased 5 promising startups from the center at 'Showstoppers' of CES 2014, the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

The companies which participated in 2014's CES are; 'Pison contents' that is provider of the first Korean global online music distribution platform 'MusicSpray', 'Hisshow', the provider of the bible animation 'Hisshowbible', 'Publstdio'; provider of an educational interactive appbook, 'Kamon Ltd'; filming system developer with 360 Degree Movie, 'CODELINE'; developer of 'easy&elly'.

Lee Wooho, HisShow Edu Director explained: "It's Christian animation. We have six stories. The reason why we make these is for children's understanding. And we translate Bible into Spanish&English. We're planning to provide 'Bible Apps' to every children."

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
